Line

class Line(settings)[source]

Bases: object

Line (segment) of the road in the pseudo-3D system.

Parameters:
settingsGameSettings

Game configuration (injected).

Attributes:
TARGET_X_BY_ROADdict[int, float], class attribute

Lateral position of a target/obstacle by lane (0 left, 1 middle).

TARGET_X_RIGHTfloat, class attribute

Lateral position for any other lane (right).

settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

x, y, zfloat

3D position of the line.

screen_x, screen_y, screen_wfloat

Projected 2D position and half width of the road on screen.

scalefloat

Projection scale.

curvefloat

Road curvature at this line.

clipfloat

Screen y below which sprites of this line are hidden (terrain in front).

passedbool

True after the camera has gone past this line (set by Background); used to detect the finish line crossing even when the road advances several segments per frame.

sprite_xfloat

Lateral offset of the left side sprite (tree).

spritepygame.Surface | None

Left side sprite.

sprite_rectpygame.Rect | None

Rect of the left side sprite.

sprite2_xfloat

Lateral offset of the right side sprite (tree).

sprite2pygame.Surface | None

Right side sprite.

sprite2_rectpygame.Rect | None

Rect of the right side sprite.

target_xfloat

Lateral offset of the target/obstacle.

targetTarget | None

Target/obstacle on this line.

target_rectpygame.Rect | None

Rect of the target/obstacle.

grass_color, rumble_color, road_color, div_colorpygame.Color

Colors of the line, set by Background when the road is created.

Methods

draw_sprite

Draw the left side sprite (left tree).

draw_sprite2

Draw the right side sprite (right tree).

draw_target

Draw the target or obstacle attached to this line.

project

Project the 3D position to 2D screen coordinates.
project(cam_x, cam_y, cam_z)[source]

Project the 3D position to 2D screen coordinates.

Parameters:
cam_x, cam_y, cam_zfloat

Camera position.

Notes

Updates scale, screen_x, screen_y and screen_w. Must only be called for lines in front of the camera (z > cam_z).

draw_sprite(draw_surface)[source]

Draw the left side sprite (left tree).

Parameters:
draw_surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on.

draw_sprite2(draw_surface)[source]

Draw the right side sprite (right tree).

Parameters:
draw_surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on.

draw_target(draw_surface)[source]

Draw the target or obstacle attached to this line.

Parameters:
draw_surfacepygame.Surface

Surface drawn on.

Notes

The lateral position comes from the target lane (TARGET_X_BY_ROAD). The hitbox is drawn too when DRAW_HITBOX is on.
